s.g: Used to form adjectives from nouns, often relational (meaning "related to X"): -ian, -ic, -ish
with a pale face (usually in the context of American Indians)
paleface (usually in the context of American Indians)
to see (repeatedly or frequently); iterative of ви́деть (vídetʹ)
to reconstitute, to reconstruct, to renew
to till (to plow in preparation for sowing)
to turn up, to plow up, to loosen (soil, snow, etc.), leaving marks on the surface
to make understand, to get across to (someone)
to learn, to study; to train for
to act of attacking military structures and personnel in Ukraine.
to stay in service, to stay employed
yedoma (a type of permafrost in the Pleistocene-age with an ice content of 50–90% by volume)
Samogitia (an ethnographic region of Lithuania, located in the north-west of the country)
alternative form of заве́са (zavésa, “curtain, screen; (figuratively) veil”)
to start to shout, to yell, to bawl, to scream
to hit with a fever, chills, or shivers
to inform, to notify, to advertise (to give public notice of; to announce publicly)
Something ridiculous, silly, or completely unsatisfactory.
to make (a number of), to knit
to impose (on), to thrust (on), to foist (off) (on)
penal damages, stipulated damages (in a civil law system, the monetary penalty for nonfulfillment of a contractual obligation)
crybaby (person whose feelings are easily hurt)
concession; giving in to someone's demands
to glorify, to sing the praises of
to untwine, to untwist, to unweave, to undo, to unbraid, to unplait
to appeal to one's conscience, shame, reproach
confident, sure, certain [with в (v, + prepositional) ‘in/of someone/something’] (of a person)
confident, firm, resolute (in general; of a person, step, tone, action, etc.)
to show excessive scrupulousness, to take too much account of anyone, anything
so that, in order that; in order to
Eiffel (referring to Gustave Eiffel, French engineer, builder of the Eiffel Tower and Statue of Liberty)
